[EVENT] User took a similar trip last month and realized they packed too many snacks.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested essential gear for solo hiking, including navigation tools, first aid kit, hydration methods, shelter and warmth, clothing layers, sturdy footwear, lighting, fire starter, food and snacks, and personal hygiene items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips to avoid overpacking, including planning meals, packing multipurpose items, limiting luxuries, packing layered clothing, using a packing list, and packing easily replaceable gear.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended snacks that are high in energy and low in weight, such as dried fruits, nuts, and energy bars, and advised against perishable items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested checking the weather forecast and local regulations or recommendations before the hike.  
[PREFERENCE] User was thinking of packing energy bars and trail mix as snacks.
